title: SSS eyes doubling branches in Eastern Visayas to improve member access

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Residents of Eastern Visayas could soon have easier access to social security services as the SocialSecuritySystem (SSS) plans to increase the number of its full-service branches in the region fromfive to at least 10or 12, with the expansion expected to begin next year. The plan includes upgrading existing service offices into full-service branches and opening additional service offices in strategic areas to serve members who currently have to travel long distances to transact with the agency.
